sanskrit: somasyendrasya varuṇasya rājño viṣṇor balena savituḥ savena | agner hotreṇa pra ṇude piśācān yaviṣṭhasya brahmaṇā jātavedasaḥ ||
english: By the might of Soma and Indra, of Varuṇa the king, by the power of Viṣṇu and the impulse of Savitṛ, by the priestly office of Agni — I drive away the piśācas by the sacred word of Jātavedas, the youngest.

sanskrit: kravyādam agne rudhiraṃ piśācaṃ manohanaṃ jahi jātavedaḥ sahobhiḥ | śraddhemaṃ brahma juṣatāṃ dakṣiṇāyur yathā jīvāty agado bhavāti ||
english: O Agni Jātavedas, smite with your powers the flesh-eating, blood-drinking piśāca, the slayer of the mind. May this sacred formula find favour with the generous one; may he live long, may he be free of disease.

sanskrit: punas tvā prāṇaḥ punar aitv āyuḥ punaś cakṣuḥ punar aitu śrotram | apaghnā no duritāni viśvā śataṃ himāḥ sarvavīrā madema ||
english: May breath return to you, may life return; may sight return to you, may hearing return. Drive away from us all misfortunes; may we rejoice through a hundred winters, possessing all heroic sons.

sanskrit: punar asmai mano dhehi punar āyuḥ punar balam | apānām asya prāṇaṃ ca- -agne vardhaya jīvase ||
english: Restore mind to him, restore life, restore strength. O Agni, increase in him both the out-breath and the in-breath, that he may live.

sanskrit: cakṣuḥ sūrya punar dehi vāta prāṇaṃ sam īraya | śarīram asya māṃsāny agne saṃ bhārayā tvam ||
english: O Sūrya, grant him sight again; O Vāyu, stir his breath back together. O Agni, restore his body and his flesh, make them whole.

sanskrit: sam ā bhara jātavedo yaj jagdhaṃ yat parābhṛtam | gātrāṇy asya kalpaya punar ā pyāyatām ayam ||
english: O Jātavedas, bring together again what has been consumed and what has been borne away. Set his limbs in order; may this man swell back to fullness.

sanskrit: somasyeva jātavedo aṃśur ā pyāyatām ayam | agne virapsinaṃ medhyam ayakṣmaṃ kṛṇu jīvase ||
english: O Jātavedas, may this man swell as the shoot of Soma swells. O Agni, make him abundant, fit for the sacred rite, free from disease, that he may live.

sanskrit: saṃ mā siñcantu maruta ity ekā ||
english: "May the Maruts sprinkle me" — so runs the single verse.

sanskrit: vi muñcāmi brahmaṇā jātavedasam agniṃ hotāram ajaraṃ rathaspṛtam | sarvā devānāṃ janimāni vidvān yathābhāgaṃ vahatu havyam agniḥ ||
english: With the sacred formula I release Jātavedas, Agni the priest, the ageless one who touches the chariot. Knowing all the birthplaces of the gods, may Agni carry the oblation, each portion to its proper share.

sanskrit: ye pumāṃso yātudhāna yā striyo yātudhānyaḥ | balavad indrasya vajreṇa- -avācīnān ava hanmi tān ||
english: The male sorcerers, the yātudhānas, and the female sorcerers, the yātudhānīs — with the mighty vajra of Indra I smite them down, driving them away to the nether regions.

sanskrit: yaṃ śapāmo ya u naḥ śapāti yaṃ dviṣmo ya u dveṣat piśācaḥ | kravyādam agne mahatā vadhena tam atrāpi pra daha jātavedaḥ ||
english: Him whom we curse and who curses us, him whom we hate and who, the piśāca, hates us — that flesh-eater, O Agni, burn him down here with a great weapon, O Jātavedas.

sanskrit: ya ārebhe yasya vā ghāsy apsarā yaḥ kṛṇvena saṃvido yātumāvān | ulūkayātuṃ bhṛmalo yasya yātus tam (…) ||
english: He who has seized someone, or the Apsarā who has devoured his substance, the sorcerer who conspires with a crafty device — he whose demon is the owl-phantom, the bhṛmala — him [burn down here, O Jātavedas].

sanskrit: ya ādade yasya vā ghāsi pitryā stena śvayātur uta saṃbhidhehibhiḥ | yaḥ patād rodhanasyādhidevanaṃ kravyāt piśācaḥ kraviṣas titṛpsan ulūkayātuṃ bhṛmalo yasya yātus tam (…) ||
english: He who has taken, or who has consumed another's ancestral property — the thief, the dog-demon, and those who conspire together; he who has fallen upon the stake of the barring-place with intent to gamble, the flesh-eating piśāca who craves raw flesh and lusts for carrion — he whose demon is the owl-phantom, the bhṛmala — him [burn down here, O Jātavedas].

sanskrit: yaḥ puruṣeṇeyate rathena kravyād yātuḥ piśunaḥ piśācaḥ | vaiśvānareṇa sayujā sūryeṇa tam (…) ||
english: He who rides with a man in the chariot — the flesh-eating, malicious yātu, the piśāca — him, with Vaiśvānara yoked together with Sūrya — him [burn down here, O Jātavedas].

sanskrit: yo no valiṃ mṛgayāṃ yaś ca naḥ kṛṣiṃ paritiṣṭhād yātubhir yaś ca naḥ śapāt | astā rudraḥ śrathatv āyur asya tam (…) ||
english: He who haunts our tribute-hunt, who has beset our tillage with sorceries, and who has cursed us — may Rudra the bowman shatter his life — him [burn down here, O Jātavedas].

sanskrit: mā yātumān vidata mṛḍitāram alokā asmai pradiśo bhavantu | sam enaṃ tapatāṃ rodasī ubhe tam atrāpi pra daha jatavedaḥ ||
english: May the sorcerer find no one to show him mercy; may all the quarters of space be lightless for him. May both heaven and earth burn him with heat — burn him down here, O Jātavedas.

sanskrit: jyotiṣmatīs tapanā yāś ca rocanā pratyoṣantīs tanvo yās te agne | tābhir me marmāṇy abhito dadasva mā tvā dabhan yātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||
english: Those luminous, scorching, and shining flames of yours, O Agni, those bodies of yours that burn in counter-fire — with those protect my vital points on all sides; may the yātudhānas not deceive you, O watcher over men.

sanskrit: āpo devīḥ piśācānām apa nahyantv āsyam | yathemaṃ mamātmānaṃ anādhṛṣya punaḥ patān ||
english: May the divine Waters bind shut the mouths of the piśācas, so that this self of mine may fall back upon them, unassailable.

sanskrit: sadaṃ puṣpe sadaṃ phale sadam indrābhirakṣite | sadā piśācā mriyantāṃ maiṣām uc cheṣi kaś cana
english: Always in flower, always in fruit, always under Indra's protection — may the piśācas die forever; may not one of them survive.

sanskrit: ye patanto yātudhānā divānaktam upācarān | rātrī mā tebhyo rakṣatv ahna ātmānaṃ pari dade ||
english: Those yātudhānas who fly about and prowl by day and by night — may Night protect me from them; to Day I entrust my self.

sanskrit: imaṃ badhnāmi te maṇiṃ dīrghāyutvāya tejase | darbhaṃ sapatnajambhanaṃ dviṣatas tapanaṃ hṛdaḥ ||
english: This amulet I bind upon you for long life and for vigour — darbha grass, crusher of rivals, scorcher of the hearts of those who hate.

sanskrit: dviṣatas tāpayan hṛdaḥ śatrūṇāṃ tāpayan manaḥ | durhārdaḥ sarvāṃs tvaṃ darbha gharma ivābhīt sutāpayan ||
english: Scorching the hearts of those who hate, burning the minds of enemies — you, O darbha, the ill-willed one, scorch them all utterly as the gharma cauldron scorches.

sanskrit: gharma ivābhitapan darbha dviṣato nitapan maṇe | hṛdaḥ sapatnānāṃ bhindhi- -indra iva virujaṃ valam ||
english: Scorching all around like the gharma, O darbha, burning down those who hate, O amulet — split apart the hearts of rivals as Indra splits the resisting Vala.

sanskrit: bhindhi darbha sapatnānāṃ hṛdayaṃ dviṣatāṃ maṇe | udyaṃ tvacam iva bhūmyāḥ śira eṣāṃ vi pātaya ||
english: Split apart, O darbha, the hearts of rivals, of those who hate, O amulet. As one strips away the crust of the earth, so send their heads flying asunder.

sanskrit: bhindhi darbha sapatnān me bhindhi me pṛtanāyataḥ | bhindhi me sarvān durhārdo bhindhi me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Split apart my rivals, O darbha; split apart those who array armies against me. Split apart all who bear me ill will, O amulet; split apart those who hate me.

sanskrit: chindhi darbha sapatnān me chindhi me pṛtanāyataḥ | chindhi me sarvān durhārdaś chindhi me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Cut through my rivals, O darbha; cut through those who array armies against me. Cut through all who bear me ill will, O amulet; cut through those who hate me.

sanskrit: vṛśca darbha sapatnān me vṛśca me pṛtanāyataḥ | vṛśca me sarvān durhārdo vṛśca me (dviṣato maṇe) ||
english: Hew down my rivals, O darbha; hew down those who array armies against me. Hew down all who bear me ill will, O amulet; hew down those who hate me.

sanskrit: kṛnta darbha sapatnān me kṛnta me pṛtanāyataḥ | kṛnta me sarvān durhārdaḥ kṛnta me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Shear through my rivals, O darbha; shear through those who array armies against me. Shear through all who bear me ill will, O amulet; shear through those who hate me.

sanskrit: piṃśa darbha sapatnān me piṃśa me pṛtanāyataḥ | piṃśa me sarvān durhārdaḥ piṃśa me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Tear to pieces my rivals, O darbha; tear to pieces those who array armies against me. Tear to pieces all who bear me ill will, O amulet; tear to pieces those who hate me.

sanskrit: vidhya darbha sapatnān me vidhya me pṛtanāyataḥ | vidhya me sarvān durhārdo vidhya me dviṣato maṇe ||
english: Pierce through my rivals, O darbha; pierce through those who array armies against me. Pierce through all who bear me ill will, O amulet; pierce through those who hate me.
